name: Poornamadah Poornamidam
text:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥
meaning: That is whole; this is whole. From the whole, the whole arises. Take the whole from the whole, and the whole remains.
purpose: A declaration of the completeness and unity of all that is: even when something is taken from the source, it remains complete. Often recited at the start or close of meditation.
supports: Contentment; wholeness; letting go of lack.
when: At the start or close of meditation.
source: Invocation of the Isha Upanishad (Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 5.1.1)
